name: Seeds
overview: Scripture reveals that seeds are a divine provision for life and sustenance, as God commanded the earth to bring forth plants and fruit trees bearing seed after their kind (Genesis 1:11, 1:29). The careful act of sowing seed is emphasized as a diligent responsibility, encouraging believers to sow continually and faithfully without knowing which efforts will prosper (Ecclesiastes 11:6). God also calls His people to sow in righteousness to receive mercy and spiritual blessing, highlighting the spiritual principle behind planting and harvest (Hosea 10:12). Additionally, God's instructions include maintaining purity in sowing, avoiding mixing seeds, which symbolizes obedience to His statutes (Leviticus 19:19).
